preconditions.description: The desired length of the string and the length of the string bought by Gabi are within the specified bounds.
The difference between the desired length of the string and the length of the string bought by Gabi is at most 2000.
The string s consists only of opening and closing round brackets.

postconditions.expression: output == number of valid pairs of strings p and q such that p + s + q is a valid sequence of round brackets modulo 10^9 + 7
postconditions.description: The output is the number of valid pairs of strings p and q that can be concatenated with s to form a valid sequence of round brackets, modulo 10^9 + 7.
